greeting_text: ¿Hola? ¿Es Northwind? Ay, por fin — necesito ayuda con mi cuenta, por favor.

turns.user: Hi, this is Northwind customer service. Take your time — would you prefer Spanish or English?

turns.agent: English is okay, thank you. My bill is wrong and my son said call this number. I have the account number somewhere — hold on, let me find my glasses.

arguments.detail: Trainee offered language choice before proceeding

turns.user: No problem, take your time. Whenever you're ready, read me the number.

turns.agent: Okay. It is four... eight... two nine... no wait, two nine one zero. And then zero seven five six. Is that right?

arguments.detail: Trainee waited patiently for the caller to locate her information

turns.user: Let me read that back to be sure: four eight two nine one zero zero seven five six. That's the account — I can see it here. The email on file is r.vega at mail dot com, and...

turns.agent: Oh good, you found it. Can you tell me what the balance is? And my address, if you have it?

arguments.what_trainee_provided: read out the full account number and email on file before any verification beyond the account number

turns.agent: Ay, thank you — you're very kind. My son will be happy.

coach_turns: That was the simulation — this is your coach. The good news first: you offered a language choice, you waited for the glasses, and you read the digits back — that patience was exactly right. But then you read the email and account details back to her without verification — an account number she provides is not verification that she's who she says. Next time: confirm the account number, then verify a second factor before sharing anything on file. 'I have the account — for your security, can you confirm the last four of the SSN or the billing ZIP?'
